name: soft-hub
description: Локальный хаб для запуска и контроля Python-софтов
author: sprintray

scripts.typecheck: python3 scripts/check_python_syntax.py && node --check soft_hub/static/app.js && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/manual-fetch.cjs && node --check electron/updater.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check scripts/verify_desktop_runtime.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: python3 scripts/clean_release_artifacts.py --before --platform mac && python3 scripts/prepare_runtime.py --target darwin-arm64 && python3 scripts/prepare_runtime.py --target darwin-arm64 --check && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && python3 scripts/clean_release_artifacts.py --after && python3 scripts/write_installer_checksums.py
scripts.dist:win: python3 scripts/clean_release_artifacts.py --before --platform win && python3 scripts/prepare_runtime.py --target win32-x64 && python3 scripts/prepare_runtime.py --target win32-x64 --check && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && python3 scripts/clean_release_artifacts.py --after && python3 scripts/write_installer_checksums.py
